# Every package the offline bundle holds, at the version it holds.
#
# requirements-dev.txt pins what we import; the rest come in as dependencies
# and moved on every refetch (six of them between 2026-09-05 and 2026-11-02),
# so the bundle on a drive and the set CI tested drifted apart unseen.
# requirements-dev.txt names this file, and the fetch, the offline bootstrap
# and CI read no other constraints, so they get one set.
#
# Regenerated from the bundle itself, the same for 3.11 to 3.14, in the
# repository's root. dev.in is requirements-dev.txt without its -c line, which
# would hold every version to the old file:
#   grep -v '^-c ' requirements-dev.txt > dev.in
#   printf 'setuptools\nwheel\npip\n' > backend.in
#   uv pip compile --offline --no-index --find-links vendor/wheels \
#     --only-binary :all: --python-version 3.11 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --no-header --no-annotate \
#     dev.in backend.in
# To move a version: change it here, refetch, commit this and SHA256SUMS.txt.
